recipes.name: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia Special
instructions: For Rum Ham:
Score the ham. - 1 Large Ham
Combine brown sugar, salt and ground pepper in a bowl. - 2 cups Brown sugar - ⅓ cup Black pepper - ½ cup Salt
Rub the ham liberally with brown sugar mixture and place in a 350°F oven for an hour and a half.
Caramelize the Pineapple in a skillet with the butter. - ½ cup pineapple - 1 ½ tbsp butter
Turn the skillet up to high heat, add the half cup of rum and flambe until all of the alcohol cooks off. - ½ cup rum
Once the ham is ready, plate and serve with pineapple rum sauce and enjoy.
For Riot Juice :
Combine grain alcohol, blue curacao and pineapple juice in a cocktail shaker. - 2 ounces grain alcohol - 2 shots blue curacao - ½ cup pineapple juice
Shake to combine and enjoy.
For Fight milk :

Combine all all ingredients in a cocktail shaker and shake vigorously to emulsify the eggs. - 1 shot vodka - 2 quail eggs - 1 cup milk - 3 ounces simple syrup - ½ teaspoon nutmeg - ½ teaspoon cinnamon - ½ teaspoon allspice
Pour and enjoy.
For Grilled Charlie:
Place brioche in a hot pan with melted butter. - 2 slices of brioche - Butter
Top with chocolate, then a slice of brie. - 1 Chocolate bar - 1 slice of brie
Smear peanut butter on the other slice of brioche and place of top. - Peanut butter
Toast like any other grilled cheese sandwich, slice and enjoy.
For Milk Steak:
Start with bacon that you’re going to render in water until you get all the fat out and it’s crispy brown. Remove bacon from pan. - ½ pound bacon - ¼ cup water
Next brown some boneless short rib in the bacon fat. - 2 boneless shortribs
Once there is a nice brown crust on the short rib, you’re going to remove them, add the bacon back in, crank up the heat, and deglaze with milk. - 2 cups milk

Scrape up all the fond off the bottom of the pot, and add chopped into fourths, some sage, rosemary, a couple cloves of garlic, and our boneless short rib. - 1 small bundle of sage leaves - 1 sprig of rosemary - 1 carrot chopped into fourths - 2 cloves garlic
Partially cover your pot and stick in a 350°F oven for about 2 hours.
Once they are butterknife tender you’re going to take them out of the liquid, let them cool, and cut them into cubes.

Next make your bacon gravy. Add bacon and flour to a pan. Cook briefly then add your milk to make your gravy. Add a little bit at a time and season accordingly. - Milk - Salt - Pepper - ¼ pound of bacon - 1 ½ tbs of flour
Cut your steak into cubes and plate them. Adding parmesan polenta cubes in line with your steak.

To make parmesan polenta cubes, pre-heat oven to 400°F and line a baking tray with baking paper. Cut polenta into cubes. Place parmesan cheese on plate and coat each polenta cube with parmesan. Bake for 30 minutes or until crispy golden brown. - Parmesan cheese - Polenta
Cover steak with your bacon gravy, garnish with some mustard microgreens, serve and enjoy! - Mustard microgreens
